The Treant Avatar is a treant that appears near the Shrine of the Warden in the High Wilderness in . To summon it, a druid must first interact with the shrine to gain . Treasures of Azeroth is a China-exclusive promotional campaign for World of Warcraft, launched on 18 November 2025 along with the Titan Reforged servers, where players spend Azerothian Treasure Coins to pull a random prize from a pool. As a form of bad luck protection, players also have a chance to pull Shard of Azeroth Fragments, which can be used to purchase prizes directly. There are different rewards based on the game version: Retail *Mechanical Prototype Panther MK-0 *Steel Prototype Panther MK-0 *Kaldorei War Wolf *Blackrock Warsaber * * *Magical Ogre Idol *Demon Hunter's Aspect *10x Sands of Time (used for Quicksand Secret Treasure Vault) *K'areshi Scientific Expedition Supply MoP Cla

Ulderoth is an alternate universe of Azeroth, visited during the Time Rifts. Ulderoth is a titan utopia where there is no Void presence, only Order and Life, as the Pantheon of Order saw their experiments through. The Freya encounter reuses the Elarian Sanctuary map from Antorus, the Burning Throne. After the encounter, a Watcher's Log of hologram generator of a yaungol appears, detailing the titanic watchers' observations and experiments on them.

The Undersea is a vast underground body of water comprising the northwestern expanse of Hallowfall, located directly beneath Beledar. From north to south, the sea is the western border of Bleak Sand, Faded Shore, Velhan's Claim, Priory of the Sacred Flame, Fortune's Fall, and Morgaen's Tears. From points north and west, the sea drains through unnamed rivers into the Hungering Pool at the center of the zone. Some among the Hallowfall Arathi refer to it as "the dark ocean" and believe that it could lead back to the sea, sending messages in bottles across the waves with the hope they will reach the shores of their homeland. It is home to many dangers, most notably the kobyss, an amphibious race

Unwaking Echos are chests located in the Emerald Dream. Four are located at various points in the Dream. The chest at the Verdant Landing is surrounded by Sleepstruck Hatchlings. The last chest is found on a floating island in the southern sea, home to Striped Skulkers and Horned Skitterbugs. These chests can only be opened while Dreaming a state reached by simply performing a /sleep emote.

Vakthros Range is a mountain range located in the eastern Azure Span, separating the Upper Frostlands to the west from Vakthros and Vakthros Summit to the east. Initially, it was frozen over and mainly inhabited by ice elementals, armoredons, and polar bears. During the War against the Primalists, Raszageth and her Primalist forces tore a hole through the range, reshaping it with fire and earth in order to clear a path to Vakthros. Now, the massive tunnel upwards serves as both a pathway and a stronghold in their battle against the Kirin Tor and Dragon Aspects, containing numerous ritual sites and elemental focuses. Valrin Paller is an Arathi located in Dunelle's Rest inn, in Dunelle's Kindness in Hallowfall. When fungarians in the Mycomancer Caverns started raiding spice crates bound for Lorel's Crossing, Valrin called on adventurers to go into those caverns and push back the fungarian menace. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Valrin answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. He was stationed at Lothar's Landing, where he could be seen healing wounded soldiers.

The Vanguard of the Light, often shortened as the Vanguard, is a coalition of champions summoned by Azeroth's worldsoul, united to oppose Xal'atath and the Devouring Host. When the Voidstorm appeared above the Isle of Quel'Danas, Lady Liadrin beseeched the Light to help them repel the Void invaders; in response, the worldsoul teleported most of the world's priests and paladins to protect the Sunwell.
